download_ownership.scratch: Unique project-local .build/*.noindex workspace registered with scripts/lib/local_cleanup.sh before invoking gh/curl.
download_ownership.temporary_directory: Force TMPDIR to an owned subdirectory before every gh call; gh2.86 uses OS TMPDIR for artifact ZIPs otherwise.
download_ownership.processes: Bounded shared run_owned.py process groups; lifecycle verification receives its existing cleanup grace.
download_ownership.transport: Prefer bounded gh artifact download; any HTTP1 fallback keeps token/signed redirect configuration in memory or mode0600 owned scratch, never argv or evidence.
download_ownership.redaction: No shell tracing, tokens, signed URL queries, response Location headers, raw curl configs or unredacted transport exceptions in retained logs.
download_ownership.retention: Only the four fully verified candidate assets move to the run-specific final directory. Archive, partials, credentials, extracted Apps and mounts remain disposable.

strict_checks: Candidate run/artifact identity matches root-provided run ID, frozen SHA, main branch and expected artifact name; require successful build and nonexpired artifact.
Match downloaded ZIP to API artifact digest/size where provided; require exact four safe regular-file ZIP entries and valid CRC before extraction.
Require exactly three unique SHA256SUMS lines covering PKG, DMG and release-info; match each digest and reject extra files/paths/duplicates.

Require exact15 release-info keys, no duplicates, version/build4.3.22, arm64+x86_64, minOS12, fixed app/helper paths, app-only DMG and app+helper PKG, community-ad-hoc signatures, unsigned PKG/DMG, notarized=no, stapled=no.
Run frozen real scripts/verify_release.sh PKG DMG without rebuilding or setting WATTSON_RELEASE_BUILD_ROOT; require its final verification marker as well as exit0.
Verify actual App/helper architecture and ad-hoc signatures for both slices, actual unsigned PKG/DMG, and PKG/DMG App byte identity; do not infer these facts from metadata alone.
After verification, require owned process termination, mount detach, disposable App unregistration and scratch deletion; preserve a mounted path and report failure if bounded detach fails.

unrelated_partial_left_untouched.reason: Outside current4.3.22 task ownership; root confirmed leave untouched.

historic_helper_audit: Old4.3.6 helper stops at metadata/signature and hosted-log evidence; it is insufficient for current real local verification. Old4.3.3 helper stages a redundant build tree; current verifier supports independent packaged inputs, so no reconstructed build is needed.
prohibited_actions: No canonical installation/helper/preferences changes, product execution, tag/source edits, commits, pushes or publication.
